components.title: Components
components.label: component
components.description: Meeko's built-in tags: you use them in the template without importing them, and the compiler checks their attributes.

macros.title: Macros
macros.label: macro
macros.description: The macros the compiler reads in the component script and the `define*` functions that declare pages, middleware, plugins, modules, the configuration and the server.

composables.title: Composables
composables.label: composable
composables.description: `use*` functions that a component script calls at its top level: the route, the page, forms, the head, the theme, state and server data.

reactivity.title: Reactivity
reactivity.label: reactivity
reactivity.description: Signals, computed values, effects, lifecycle, context and error observers: the core, without a virtual DOM.

utils.title: Utilities
utils.label: utility
utils.description: Typed routes, redirects, API errors, generated clients, serialization, trusted HTML and passwords.

syntax.title: .meeko syntax
syntax.label: syntax
syntax.description: What the compiler recognizes in a `.meeko` file: interpolation, directives, snippets and the component blocks.

server.title: Server
server.label: server
server.description: Sessions and their stores, security headers, OpenAPI, local calls, cross-instance Socket and process errors.

adapters.title: Adapters
adapters.label: adapter
adapters.description: How the built application runs on Node, Bun, Deno and Cloudflare Workers.

commands.title: Commands
commands.label: command
commands.description: The `meeko` CLI: development, checking, build, production server, new projects and tools.

config.title: Configuration
config.label: configuration
config.description: The keys of `meeko.config.ts`, which is declared with `defineMeekoConfig`.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.label: advanced API
advanced.description: The pieces beneath the framework, for custom hosts, tools and tailored builds.

autoimport:useApi.description: Reads an API endpoint from a component, with SSR, hydration and contract types.

autoimport:useApiMutation.description: Sends a mutation to an API endpoint, with its pending state and its errors.

autoimport:useRpcQuery.description: Reads an RPC procedure from a component, with SSR and hydration.

autoimport:useRpcMutation.description: Calls an RPC procedure that changes data, with its pending state and its errors.

autoimport:useSocket.description: Connects a component to a server Socket channel with its typed events.

autoimport:api.description: Generated client for the `server/api` endpoints, typed by their contracts.

autoimport:rpc.description: Generated client for the `server/rpc` procedures, typed by their contracts.

cli:dev.description: Development server: prepares the types and starts the application with Vite and HMR.

cli:build.description: Checks the project and generates the production output for its adapter.

cli:start.description: Starts the production server from the build.

cli:preview.description: Runs the build output in its runtime: Node, Bun, Deno or `wrangler dev`.

cli:check.description: Checks a project or a `.meeko` component with TypeScript and Meeko's diagnostics.

cli:clean.description: Deletes what Meeko generates: `.meeko/` and the Vite cache; with `--all`, also `node_modules`.

cli:init.description: Creates a standalone SSR project with a `.meeko` component.

cli:init-framework.description: Creates a full-stack application with pages, layouts, server and types.

cli:auth hash.description: Prompts for a password without showing it, or reads it from stdin, and prints its hash.

cli:routes.description: Discovers routes, contracts and auto-imports and writes the manifests and types in `.meeko/`.

cli:prerender.description: Prerenders the `render: "prerender"` routes on top of an existing build.

cli:compile.description: Compiles a `.meeko` component to a TypeScript module.

cli:types.description: Generates the type declarations of a `.meeko` component.

cli:check-app.description: Checks every component of the application.

cli:lsp.description: Language server for `.meeko` over stdio, the one editors use.
